user.title: Connect an ESPHome ERV monitor
user.description: Select the ESPHome device already receiving Broan ERV telemetry. ESPHome continues to provide the connection to the ERV.

sources.title: Select ERV telemetry
sources.description: Select Active Mode (text or numeric) and any other sensors to import. Suggested matches must be checked. Leave optional fields empty to omit them. Keep the ESPHome source entities enabled.

error.invalid_source: Select an enabled ESPHome entity on the chosen device with the correct sensor type.

abort.already_configured: This ESPHome device is already configured.
abort.device_missing: The source ESPHome device no longer exists. Add its replacement as a new ERV.
abort.no_sources: No enabled sensor entities were found. Add the device through ESPHome and enable its ERV telemetry first.
